meta.title: StayProfit | Rental Profit Calculator
meta.description: Calculate your real net operating income after platform fees and monthly expenses. Know Your Real Rental Profit. Fast and simple.

theme.label: Theme
calc.title: Rental Profit Calculator
calc.subtitle: Enter your rental assumptions and see your monthly and annual net operating income instantly.

field.nightlyPrice.label: Nightly price

field.occupancyRate.label: Occupancy rate

field.platformFeeRate.label: Platform fee rate
field.platformFeeRate.hint: Percentage deducted from gross booking revenue (0 to 100).
field.cleaningCostPerBooking.label: Cleaning cost per booking
field.cleaningCostPerBooking.hint: Cleaning amount paid for each booking (in the selected currency).

field.maintenance.label: Maintenance and repairs
field.maintenance.hint: Average monthly amount (in the selected currency).
field.electricity.label: Electricity
field.electricity.hint: Average monthly amount (in the selected currency).
field.water.label: Water
field.water.hint: Average monthly amount (in the selected currency).
field.internet.label: Internet
field.internet.hint: Monthly internet subscription (in the selected currency).
field.insurance.label: Insurance
field.insurance.hint: Monthly insurance premium. You can enter the annual premium divided by 12.
field.propertyManagement.label: Property management fee
field.propertyManagement.hint: Monthly fee for a professional property manager (in the selected currency).
field.otherExpenses.label: Other expenses
field.otherExpenses.hint: Total of dues, subscriptions and other monthly costs (in the selected currency).
result.title: Results
note.annualAssumption: Annual values are calculated as monthly values × 12.
note.noConversion: Currency is for display only; no exchange rate conversion is applied.
note.storage: Only your language and theme (light/dark) preferences are stored in your browser; financial data is not stored.
errors.NOT_AN_INTEGER: This field must be a whole number.
errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: The value is outside the allowed range.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The value is too large; at most {max} can be entered.
errors.BOOKINGS_EXCEED_BOOKED_NIGHTS: Bookings cannot exceed the number of booked nights ({max}).
errors.RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The calculated result is outside the expected range.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_NUMBER: Thousands and decimal separators are ambiguous (e.g. 1.234 or 1,234). Please write the number in a clear format.
errors.loadFailed: The selected language file could not be loaded; showing the fallback language.
errors.loadFailedHint: Make sure the app is running through the server: npm start
footer.disclaimer: Results are estimates only and do not constitute tax, legal or investment advice.
mode.label: Calculation mode
mode.seasonalHint: Enter a separate price and occupancy for each of the 12 months.
seasonal.title: Monthly price and occupancy
seasonal.year.label: Year
seasonal.year.hint: The number of days in February changes by year.
seasonal.averageStay.label: Average stay length (nights)
seasonal.averageStay.hint: 1–365; used to estimate the number of bookings, and cleaning cost is based on it.
seasonal.applyAll.title: Apply to all months
seasonal.applyAll.hint: Copy the values below to all 12 months at once.
seasonal.table.title: Monthly breakdown
seasonal.table.caption: Monthly gross revenue, platform fee, cleaning, operating expenses and net operating income (estimated).
result.annualNetSeasonal: Annual net operating income (sum of 12 months)
note.seasonalEstimate: Seasonal results are estimates. The annual value is the actual calculated sum of 12 months, not monthly × 12.
note.bookingsEstimate: Booking counts are average estimates; fractional values are not rounded.
calc.sampleNoticeSeasonal: Seasonal values are SAMPLE data. Results are calculated live when you change them.
